title: Make known-finding regressions test the actual generalized defect
description:
For durable known findings, make regression evidence evaluate the violated invariant
rather than merely select a registry row or prove baseline existence. Scope each
predicate to the known defect class and a justified affected population; do not invent
a universal mechanic census.
acceptance_criteria:
- Each supported known finding has regression evidence that distinguishes repaired from defective state.
- Sibling cases within the known defect class are covered where independently identifiable.
- Unevaluable/unresolvable findings remain unresolved and cannot pass through an empty result.
- Corpus-wide claims are used only when the exact bounded population is independently established.
- The finding registry remains audit-fact authority, not executable-universe authority.
